description: This file contains an abstract class 'LegendRenderer' responsible for rendering chart legends within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for formatting and drawing the legend, handling layout calculations, and rendering borders. The class is part of the 'PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers' namespace and interacts with other classes like 'ChartRendererInfo', 'LegendEntryRenderer', and rendering parameters.

classes.name: LegendRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for rendering chart legends, including layout calculations and the drawing process.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the layout and space allocation for the legend, including entry sizes, padding, and border considerations.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Handles rendering the legend on the graphics context, including positioning individual entries and optionally drawing a border.
